prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Desktop Pet Visibility Check", "Can you see your pet floating on your desktop right now? Confirm display settings if hidden.", "Display Active", "Pet Is Visible"]
1: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Your new desktop friend is officially registered! Review details and bring them home.", "Certificate Approved"]
2: ["Signing into your existing account automatically restores all previously adopted desktop pets."]
3: ["Choose How to Create Your Desktop Pet", "Scroll through path options: pick a preset companion or create a custom pet from photos."]
4: ["We are analyzing photo lighting and contours to build a high-quality 3D desktop sprite."]
5: ["Desktop Pet Quick Start Checklist", "Learn the essential mouse gestures and shortcuts to manage your pet on your desktop.", "Got It!"]
6: ["Creating Your Desktop Companion", "Relax while your companion's animations, voice tones, and movement AI load in background."]
7: ["Sign In to Save Your Pet Progress", "Connect your account to sync pet data across desktop devices instantly.", "Network Connected"]
8: ["Meet Your Future Desktop Buddy", "Watch a quick preview of how virtual pets live on your desktop while you work.", "Choose My Pet Path"]
9: ["Onboarding Complete - Special Gift Unlocked!", "You unlocked an exclusive starter accessory for your desktop pet. Click finish to place them on your screen.", "Starter Accessory Unlocked", "Claim Gift & Launch Pet"]
